blinding_guess.why: The FlightMode enum (0-8, 10-12, 14-21), the HEARTBEAT custom_mode (= control_mode), the SET_MODE whitelist in mavlink_set_mode (every enumerator except INITIALISING) and the FLTMODE/INITIAL_MODE @Values docs agree at this revision; the only oddity is a latent uint32 to uint8 narrowing of SET_MODE.custom_mode through set_mode_fn.

notes: Not a ROS package: firmware source tree (ArduPilot) with MAVLink transport; QoS fields are null (ROS 1 generation, no QoS concept). The MAVLink message definitions (common.xml for HEARTBEAT and SET_MODE) are not in the snapshot (modules/mavlink submodule directory is empty) and XML is not an allowed dependency file type, so all definition_id values are null and the HEARTBEAT.custom_mode field type is taken from the package's own sending code (uint32_t). api:FlightMode enumerators at snapshot:ArduPlane/defines.h:49-68: MANUAL = 0, CIRCLE = 1, STABILIZE = 2, TRAINING = 3, ACRO = 4, FLY_BY_WIRE_A = 5, FLY_BY_WIRE_B = 6, CRUISE = 7, AUTOTUNE = 8, AUTO = 10, RTL = 11, LOITER = 12, AVOID_ADSB = 14, GUIDED = 15, INITIALISING = 16, QSTABILIZE = 17, QHOVER = 18, QLOITER = 19, QLAND = 20, QRTL = 21. HEARTBEAT: custom_mode carries control_mode (enum FlightMode) cast to uint32_t, base_mode always has MAV_MODE_FLAG_CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED (ArduPlane/GCS_Mavlink.cpp:13,97), autopilot MAV_AUTOPILOT_ARDUPILOTMEGA, type MAV_TYPE_FIXED_WING. SET_MODE: custom_mode is used only when packet.base_mode has MAV_MODE_FLAG_CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED (GCS_Common.cpp:1460); it is passed to set_mode_fn, declared FUNCTOR_TYPEDEF(set_mode_fn, bool, uint8_t) (libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS.h:244), so the uint32 value is narrowed to uint8_t before Plane::mavlink_set_mode(uint8_t mode) (ArduPlane/Plane.h:995, system.cpp:506-532) switches on it; INITIALISING (16) and unlisted numbers return false. With base_mode == MAV_MODE_FLAG_DECODE_POSITION_SAFETY, custom_mode 0/1 instead forces safety off/on (GCS_Common.cpp:1464-1476). SET_MODE.base_mode is also referenced but is not a packet element. MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MODE (GCS_Mavlink.cpp:1483-1505) maps only param1 base modes and does not read a custom mode. Incoming HEARTBEAT is read only for GCS failsafe timing (GCS_Mavlink.cpp:1956-1962). The code references many other MAVLink messages that are unrelated to the packet elements and are not listed in references. exclusive is empty: no exclusive claim relates to the listed elements; firmware-wide hardware ownership was not catalogued. perm_requires is absent at element level; link-level MAVLink2 signing exists (libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS_Signing.cpp) and applies to all messages. manifest_version is the firmware version from version.h (typed BETA), since there is no ROS manifest.
